target_customer: Municipal water utilities that pay for software to find lost revenue and water
problem: Utilities lose revenue to meter errors, billing gaps and leaks and lacked analytics on their own data.

founders.name: Christine Boyle
education: PhD (institution not stated on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page bio. Company was a spinout of the Environmental Finance Center at UNC Chapel Hill per search summary.

technical_complexity.rationale: Data integration with utility billing and meter systems plus analytics, with a team of two.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded in utility data pipelines and sold through long public sector cycles.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Aclara formed an alliance with Valor and Xylem acquired it in 2018.

market_need_then: Drought and conservation reduced water sales, squeezing utility revenue; TechCrunch coverage in 2014 described utilities staying afloat as customers conserve.

brand_strength.rationale: Sold to utilities through relationships; valorwater.com now redirects to Xylem.

outcome_analysis: Valor sold analytics to water utilities, raised a 1.6 million dollar seed in 2016 and was acquired by Xylem in early 2018, with the founder staying on as a Xylem vice president. Price is undisclosed, but a strategic exit for a tiny team suggests a successful niche outcome.
notes: valorwater.com redirects to a Xylem product page. Acquisition date conflicts (Feb 2 2018 per one source, March 5 2018 per CB Insights). Earlier small rounds (130K in 2014, 20K Tumml) appear only in aggregators and are not recorded. A 2.8M total figure could not be reconciled. No dated competitor sources found. Founder PhD institution not stated.
